title: rSTEMMUS_SCOPE: Octave/MATLAB/MCR multi-engine execution of STEMMUS-SCOPE from R
description: R interface and numerical hardening for STEMMUS-SCOPE, adding GNU Octave and MATLAB Runtime (MCR) execution alongside MATLAB, with ten defensive numerical guards validated by a guard-ablation experiment. Includes the run and validation scripts, archived ablation outputs and a mapping of every result in the accompanying Computers & Geosciences manuscript to the script that produces it (README, section 'Reproducing the results').
